other_failure_modes.name: Data leakage via global categorical encoding
other_failure_modes.description: Categorical encoding (such as frequency encoding) is computed on the combined train and test dataset before splitting, which leaks the distribution of the test set into the training features.

other_failure_modes.name: No target transformation for highly skewed variable
other_failure_modes.description: The target variable is a volumetric quantity (reservoir capacity) that likely spans multiple orders of magnitude. Training directly on the raw scale with an RMSE objective makes the model overly sensitive to massive outliers, whereas a log-transformation would be more appropriate and robust.

summary: The agent successfully implements a cross-validated XGBoost model with some domain-specific spatial and geometric feature engineering. However, it introduces data leakage by computing frequency encodings on the combined train and test sets. Additionally, it fails to apply a log transformation to the highly skewed target variable (reservoir capacity) and relies entirely on RMSE without considering the disproportionate impact of outliers.
